integrity: The all-profile formula follows analytically from orthogonal least squares; the sharp hierarchy follows from Cauchy–Schwarz and balanced extremizing path families. Exact-rational finite checks are corroborative and not an infinite proof. General square-root growth and a shortcut family are acknowledged as prior results. Independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple unweighted two-terminal networks formed by internally vertex-disjoint paths; the sharp square-root coefficient holds within this class for each fixed minimum path length and is not a universal all-graph constant. No weighted-graph or overlapping-path assertion.
title: Exact endpoint norms of electrical projections on parallel-path networks
